text:
```yaml
name: Rebuild Model Site

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main ]

jobs:
  rebuild-model-site:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    
    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v4
    
    - name: Set up Python
      uses: actions/setup-python@v4
      with:
        python-version: '3.10'
        
    - name: Install dependencies
      run: |
        python -m pip install --upgrade pip
        pip install -e .
        
    - name: Run model site rebuild
      run: |
        python -m policyengine_us.tools.rebuild_model_site
        
    - name: Upload rebuilt site artifacts
      uses: actions/upload-artifact@v3
      with:
        name: model-site
        path: build/
        
    - name: Run tests
      run: |
        python -m pytest tests/ -x -v
        
    - name: Check code formatting
      run: |
        python -m black --check .
        python -m flake8 .
        
    - name: Run linting
      run: |
        python -m mypy policyengine_us/
```
